title: Senior content manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting Move Up Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.To be more specific, you will:Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and i Gaming innovations
Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.The ideal profileWe’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.You are someone who:Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
Has i Gaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing itYou bring strong CM fundamentals:High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
Ownership mindset over site and content performance
Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
Experience working with CMS platformsYou work well with others and think ahead:Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potentialFeeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process ✅1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with Move Up Media
Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What’s in it for youA full time remote work environment.
A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!Move Up MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of i Gaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Our approachWe focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.

title: Engenheiro de dados gcp (dbt e etl) sr
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SRDescrição do Cargo:
Será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizandoDBTe tecnologias do ecossistemaGoogle Cloud (Big Query, Cloud Storage, Looker ML, etc.).Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.Principais Responsabilidades:
Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelinesde dados utilizandoDBT , com otimização de macros e templates.
Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dadosno Google Cloud (Big Query), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.
I mplementar e manter processos de ETL , garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.
Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.
Analisar e reestruturar processos de ETL , facilitando a migração para a nova arquitetura de dados.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções escaláveis.Requisitos e Qualificações:
✔ Experiência sólida comDBT , modelagem de dados e práticas de orquestração de pipelines
✔ Conhecimento avançado emBig Querye estruturação de dados noGoogle Cloud Platform (GCP)
✔ Proficiência emSQLpara otimização e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados
✔ Experiência comPythonpara desenvolvimento de scripts de transformação e automação de dados
✔ Conhecimento avançado emETL(Informatica Power Center, Talend, Data Stage, Hadoop, entre outros)
✔ Experiência prévia emprojetos de migração de dadose integração entre diferentes plataformas
✔Experiência sólida com Look ML , incluindo desenvolvimento de modelos de dados, definição de métricas, organização de camadas semânticas e aplicação de boas práticas de governança e reutilização
✔Diferencial:Vivência no setor financeiro e familiaridade com práticas de governança de dadosBenefícios e Diferenciais:
♂ Parceria com Total Pass para acesso a academias e atividades físicas.
Oportunidades de treinamento e cursos em tecnologias de dados.
Auxílio com certificações oficiais, com100% de reembolso ou vouchers.
Parcerias com instituições de ensino para graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.
Contratação PJ.
Trabalho 100% remoto , atuando em cliente do segmento financeiro.

title: Support specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: ). Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!About the opportunity
As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.
﻿ This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew.We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?Key Responsibilities:Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
Customer Support
Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
Documentation & Reporting
Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
Escalation Management
Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.Skills & Qualifications:Technical Expertise:
Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, mac OS, Linux) and common software applications.
Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
Problem-solving Ability:
An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
Communication Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
Organizational Skills:
Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.Preferred Experience:Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, i OS).
Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
Previous work with an American company
Education & Certifications:Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern Saa S platforms.Who You Are:
A solid technical aptitude- we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
Passion for helping others internally and externally
Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
In addition, we give bonus points for having a Saa S or Ecommerce background!

title: Alteryx server specialist - latam based
description:
Position Summary
Data Meaning is a front-runner in Business Intelligence and Data Analytics consulting, renowned for our high-quality consulting services throughout the US and LATAM. Our expertise lies in delivering tailored solutions in Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, and Project Management. We are dedicated to bringing premier services to our diverse clientele. We have a global team of 95+ consultants, all working remotely, embodying a collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven work culture.Position Overview
We are proactively building a pipeline of experienced Alteryx Specialists who are passionate about data analytics and business intelligence. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on exciting projects, leveraging your expertise in Alteryx to drive data-driven decision-making across the organization.Responsibilities:
Utilize Alteryx as the primary tool to design, develop, and implement data analytics workflows, ETL processes, and data integration solutions.
Collaborate with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into actionable insights using Alteryx.
Apply additional skills, such as Power BI or other relevant tools, to enhance data visualization and reporting capabilities for client projects.
Communicate with clients in a professional and client-facing manner, ensuring clear understanding of requirements, project updates, and deliverables.
Perform data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation tasks using Alteryx and other relevant tools.

Conduct data quality assessments and implement data validation processes to ensure accuracy and integrity of the outputs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate Alteryx outputs with Tableau, Power BI, or other reporting tools.
Stay updated with the latest industry trends and advancements in Alteryx and related technologies to continuously enhance technical skills and provide innovative solutions to clients.
Provide technical support and assistance to clients during the implementation and deployment of Alteryx workflows.Qualifications:
Strong proficiency in Alteryx Designer, with a deep understanding of Alteryx workflows, formulas, macros, and data integration processes.
Proficiency with Alteryx Server
Additional skills in Power BI or other data visualization tools are highly preferred.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact with clients in a professional and client-facing manner.
Fluency in Spanish is a huge plus, enabling effective communication with clients in the LATAM market.
Experience in data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation using Alteryx and other relevant tools.
Knowledge of ETL processes and data integration techniques.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with great attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

title: Direct response ads | video editor
description:
About Hydroh:We’re one of the fastest-growing Shopify-based DTC brands in the world at the forefront of all things hydrogen water.Our product line includes hydrogen water bottles, supplements, and accessories all designed to help people recover faster, reduce inflammation, and feel their best.We’re looking for a Performance Video Editor who deeply understands how to cut direct response ads for Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Tik Tok, and You Tube Shorts. This is NOT a branding video role we’re talking scroll-stopping hooks, retention-driven pacing, and revenue-first editing.Compensation & Perks:
Base Salary + Performance Bonus (Depending on experience and skillset)
Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)
Fully Remote
Resources, trainings, and courses covered we invest in our people.
What We're Looking For
2+ years experience editing direct response video ads for DTC brands
Portfolio of paid ads you've edited (Meta, Tik Tok, YT Shorts — performance-focused)
Advanced skills in Adobe Premiere, After Effects, or equivalent
Strong understanding of performance editing — you know what makes a video convert
Experience editing UGC-style content, influencer videos, and testimonial formats
Ability to follow creative briefs and storyboards, but also contribute your own ideas
Comfortable with iterating quickly based on feedback and performance data
Clear communicator and proactive with timelines
Bonus Points:
Experience working with health & wellness or skincare brands
Familiarity with tools like Frame.io, Slack, and Notion
Understanding of hooks, angles, and stages of awareness
Editing for long-form VSLsWhat you'll be doing:
Edit short-form performance videos (15–90 seconds) optimized for Meta and Tik Tok
Implement scroll-stopping hooks, fast-paced edits, dynamic subtitles, and retention overlays
Work closely with our Creative Strategist and UGC Project Manager to execute on weekly ad briefs
Repurpose UGC content, testimonials, and influencer clips into winning ad angles
Apply performance data to iterate and improve ad creatives week over week
Deliver assets fast we move quickly and expect tight turnaround when neededHow to apply?
Apply directly via Linked In
Attach your resume and portfolio of previous works
We’re looking to hire immediately — so if you’re an editor who gets performance, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Immigration paralegal (portuguese speaker)
description:
Company Description
Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.Role Description
We are seeking a detail-oriented and organizedFamily-Based Immigration Paralegalto join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.Key Responsibilities
Prepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documents
Collect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy
Maintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-ups
Communicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiries
Assist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidance
Draft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materials
Monitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs)
Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulations
Handle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalismQualifications
Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases
Strong working knowledge of USCIS forms and procedures
Excellent organizational and time-management skills
Strong written and verbal communication abilities
Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
Bilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only
﻿
To Apply
To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to. Please include your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

title: Web3 & al investment analyst
description:

title: Legal assistant
description:

Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred

title: Senior business analyst – supply chain
description:
Who We Are
We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.
Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.Who We Are Looking For
We are currently seeking aSenior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).
This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.
If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.Key Responsibilities
Business Requirements & Client Engagement
• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.Solution Design, Implementation & Testing
• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.Must Have
• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Availability to travel.
• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
• A collaborative and international work environment.
• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.Why Hoist?
If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.
Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Senior java software engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with UsOur company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.We're Looking for You!Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.Your Role:Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
Write automated tests and document your code
Participate in code review sessions
Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final productWhat We Need from You:Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:Technical Bachelor's degree
Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
Pragmatic and goal-oriented
Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
Image processing/computer vision skills are a plusWhat We OfferFlat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
Competitive salary
Training, coaching, and certifications
Periodic performance evaluations
Performance or special occasion bonuses
Remote work
Team buildings
Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers

title: Investment banking intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program
Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.We are activelyscreening thousands of top students globallyto identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered inpartnership with leading boutique investment banksin key markets, includingthe US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.Only two students are selected per quarterfor this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.What You'll Gain:
Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
3-Statement Financial Modeling
Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
Trading Comparables (Comps)

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Senior closer
description:
The Differs Company
A The Differs Company ajuda criadores, marcas e empreendedores a se destacarem no digital através de posicionamento estratégico, branding e conteúdos de alto impacto.
Nosso ecossistema inclui mentorias, cursos, consultorias e suporte para crescimento real de negócios, sempre orientado a resultados concretos. Trabalhamos diretamente com o perfil no Instagram, cuja audiência engajada soma centenas de milhares de seguidores, oferecendo oportunidades de venda tanto B2 C quanto B2 B.
Descrição da vaga
Estamos em busca de um(a) closer para trabalhar 100% remotamente, com experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas, que saiba conduzir leads do primeiro contato até o fechamento, sem desistir no meio do caminho.
Você será responsável por:
Conduzir calls estratégicas com leads qualificados
Diagnosticar o cenário do cliente e propor soluções de alto valor
Fechar vendas de mentorias, produtos digitais e consultorias B2 B
Lidar com objeções de forma madura e estratégica
Manter registro completo das interações em CRM Oportunidade de crescimento: quem performar acima da média poderá atuar em vendas B2 B de tickets mais altos e consultorias estratégicas.
Qualificações
Experiência comprovada como closer e em vendas consultivas
Capacidade de sustentar a negociação até o fechamento
Perfil persistente, estratégico e orientado a resultados
Habilidade de lidar com objeções complexas
Diferencial: experiência em vendas de mentorias ou produtos de alto valor
Comunicação clara e assertiva, com repertório para conversar com clientes exigentes
Excelente em gramática da Língua Portuguesa Como se candidatar

Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Emerging market trader
description:

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.

FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.

Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.

Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments

With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. title: Business process analyst i
description:
Descrição da função:1. Design e Documentação de Processos GTM
Documentar e aprimorar os principais processos de execução de GTM (Go-To-Market), incluindo:
Transferência de leads e demanda
Fluxo de oportunidades e negociações
Adoção, renovações e estratégias de expansão
Definir claramente responsabilidades, transições entre equipes e expectativas em cada etapa
Identificar lacunas de execução, pontos de atrito e inconsistências
Produzir mapas de processo, documentação clara e playbooks leves

Alinhar definições e uso das métricas entre as equipes
Criar visualizações simples ou dashboards para identificar problemas e riscos na execução
Usar insights para recomendar melhorias específicas nos processos
3. Colaboração Multifuncional
Facilitar reuniões de trabalho com times de Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e Operações
Registrar decisões e transformá-las em documentação clara
Apoiar iniciativas das equipes com análises estruturadas e acompanhamento contínuo

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando aevolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiênciasinteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!O desafio
Buscamos umSenior Data Engineerpara liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você teráalto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.O que você vai fazer:
Desenhar, implementar e evoluir aarquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo delakehousena AWS;
Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos desegurança, governança e compliance ;
Lidar comdados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base paraprodutos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.O que esperamos de você:
Experiência sólida comoData Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
Domínio de Python e SQLpara construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
Experiência prática comAWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
Conhecimento e uso deInfraestrutura como Código (Ia C) ;
Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação comsegurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
Experiência emambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.Benefícios que oferecemos:
Modelo remoto prioritário
Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação
30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano
Day off no aniversário
Total Pass (incluindo Total Mind)
Acesso ao Wework
Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo

title: Alteryx server specialist - latam based
description:
Position Summary
Data Meaning is a front-runner in Business Intelligence and Data Analytics consulting, renowned for our high-quality consulting services throughout the US and LATAM. Our expertise lies in delivering tailored solutions in Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, and Project Management. We are dedicated to bringing premier services to our diverse clientele. We have a global team of 95+ consultants, all working remotely, embodying a collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven work culture.Position Overview
We are proactively building a pipeline of experienced Alteryx Specialists who are passionate about data analytics and business intelligence. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on exciting projects, leveraging your expertise in Alteryx to drive data-driven decision-making across the organization.Responsibilities:
Utilize Alteryx as the primary tool to design, develop, and implement data analytics workflows, ETL processes, and data integration solutions.
Collaborate with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into actionable insights using Alteryx.
Apply additional skills, such as Power BI or other relevant tools, to enhance data visualization and reporting capabilities for client projects.
Communicate with clients in a professional and client-facing manner, ensuring clear understanding of requirements, project updates, and deliverables.
Perform data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation tasks using Alteryx and other relevant tools.
Develop and maintain documentation for Alteryx workflows, including workflow diagrams, data dictionaries, and user guides.
Conduct data quality assessments and implement data validation processes to ensure accuracy and integrity of the outputs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate Alteryx outputs with Tableau, Power BI, or other reporting tools.
Stay updated with the latest industry trends and advancements in Alteryx and related technologies to continuously enhance technical skills and provide innovative solutions to clients.
Provide technical support and assistance to clients during the implementation and deployment of Alteryx workflows.Qualifications:
Strong proficiency in Alteryx Designer, with a deep understanding of Alteryx workflows, formulas, macros, and data integration processes.
Proficiency with Alteryx Server
Additional skills in Power BI or other data visualization tools are highly preferred.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact with clients in a professional and client-facing manner.
Fluency in Spanish is a huge plus, enabling effective communication with clients in the LATAM market.
Experience in data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation using Alteryx and other relevant tools.
Knowledge of ETL processes and data integration techniques.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with great attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Legal assistant
description:
Position OverviewGemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.Key Responsibilities
Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials

title: Llm scientist
description:
We are looking for an \" LLM Scientist \" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.Key Responsibilities
Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.
Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.About Our Client
Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.

Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.

title: Software engineer iii
description:
Top 3 habilidades técnicas obrigatórias:Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e microsserviços, frameworks Java Script e banco de dados SQL/PostgresVisão geral da posição
ComoEngenheiro(a) de Software Principalna equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
A equipe de Administração de Membros é responsável por fornecer aos clientes do ACC ferramentas para gerenciar usuários e permissões de hubs e projetos. Trabalhamos diretamente com nossos clientes para oferecer soluções para alguns de seus maiores desafios em gestão de construção. Você desempenhará um papel crítico em transformar essas soluções em realidade.
O ACC melhora a gestão da construção e capacita todos os construtores com equipes conectadas, fluxos de trabalho e dados por meio de uma plataforma onde os usuários podem interagir de forma fluida e eficiente ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da construção. Nosso objetivo é economizar tempo eliminando redundâncias e oferecendo uma única plataforma que equipes inteiras podem usar para compartilhar informações de forma eficaz. Estamos construindo o futuro do software de construção.Responsabilidades
Projetar, codificar, testar, depurar e documentar novas e existentes funcionalidades para garantir que a aplicação atenda às necessidades de negócio, qualidade e operação
Construir código robusto e de alta qualidade e estabelecer/manter altos padrões de qualidade e testes
Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software
Interpretar e traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e tarefas
Aplicar habilidades de resolução de problemas técnicos para projetar soluções de arquitetura seguras e escaláveis
Pesquisar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias
Identificar riscos e propor estratégias de mitigação relacionadas à arquitetura da aplicação
Participar ativamente de revisões de código e pull requests
Colaborar com diversas equipes dentro da ACS, tanto locais quanto internacionais
Atender, em regime de rodízio, incidentes críticos fora do horário comercial ou nos fins de semana para garantir disponibilidade 24/7 da plataformaQualificações mínimas
Mais de 8 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias web
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em produção com aplicações em infraestrutura de nuvem em larga escala
Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
Experiência avançada com frameworks Java Script (Node.js, React)
Experiência avançada com SQL/Postgres
Forte conhecimento em AWS e arquiteturas em nuvem
Experiência sólida com ferramentas de manutenção e monitoramento de aplicações
Experiência sólida na criação de automações e pipelines de CI/CD
Experiência liderando uma equipe de pelo menos 3 engenheiros de software
Familiaridade com Docker para criação de aplicações containerizadas
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos
Paixão por crescimento, aprendizado e mentoria

Aqui na Arauc transformamos ideias em software, viabilizando o empreendedorismo com startups e digitalizando operações de empresas estabelecidas. Desenvolvemos desde aplicativos mobile e sistemas web até arquiteturas em nuvem, automações e Inteligência Artificial. Somos uma empresa jovem em crescimento, com projetos em diferentes setores e um ambiente que valoriza inovação, autonomia e aprendizado constante.O Desafio:
Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Full Stack - (Remoto) para atuar na construção de sistemas completos e MVPs.
Buscamos pessoas proativas, curiosas e apaixonadas por programação, que queiram crescer junto com a gente e deixar sua marca em produtos usados por milhares de pessoas.

Desenvolver aplicações completas (front-end + back-end + cloud + deploy)

Trabalhar com banco de dados e lógica de backend
Fazer deploy e gerenciar aplicações em nuvem

Colaborar na evolução dos produtos e melhorias contínuasQualificações
Conhecimento em desenvolvimento Full Stack
Familiaridade com pelo menos uma stack web
Noções de banco de dados
Conhecimento básico de cloud (AWS, GCP ou Firebase)
Capacidade de aprender rápido e se virar com problemas novos
Boa comunicação e organizaçãoDesejável

Experiência com deploy de aplicações
Noção de produto

title: Direct response ads | video editor
description:
About Hydroh:We’re one of the fastest-growing Shopify-based DTC brands in the world at the forefront of all things hydrogen water.Our product line includes hydrogen water bottles, supplements, and accessories all designed to help people recover faster, reduce inflammation, and feel their best.We’re looking for a Performance Video Editor who deeply understands how to cut direct response ads for Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Tik Tok, and You Tube Shorts. This is NOT a branding video role we’re talking scroll-stopping hooks, retention-driven pacing, and revenue-first editing.Compensation & Perks:
Base Salary + Performance Bonus (Depending on experience and skillset)
Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)
Fully Remote
Resources, trainings, and courses covered we invest in our people.
What We're Looking For
2+ years experience editing direct response video ads for DTC brands
Portfolio of paid ads you've edited (Meta, Tik Tok, YT Shorts — performance-focused)
Advanced skills in Adobe Premiere, After Effects, or equivalent
Strong understanding of performance editing — you know what makes a video convert
Experience editing UGC-style content, influencer videos, and testimonial formats
Ability to follow creative briefs and storyboards, but also contribute your own ideas
Comfortable with iterating quickly based on feedback and performance data
Clear communicator and proactive with timelines
Bonus Points:
Experience working with health & wellness or skincare brands
Familiarity with tools like Frame.io, Slack, and Notion
Understanding of hooks, angles, and stages of awareness
Editing for long-form VSLsWhat you'll be doing:
Edit short-form performance videos (15–90 seconds) optimized for Meta and Tik Tok
Implement scroll-stopping hooks, fast-paced edits, dynamic subtitles, and retention overlays
Work closely with our Creative Strategist and UGC Project Manager to execute on weekly ad briefs
Repurpose UGC content, testimonials, and influencer clips into winning ad angles
Apply performance data to iterate and improve ad creatives week over week
Deliver assets fast we move quickly and expect tight turnaround when neededHow to apply?
Apply directly via Linked In
Attach your resume and portfolio of previous works
We’re looking to hire immediately — so if you’re an editor who gets performance, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Web3 & al investment analyst
description:
Web3 DXBis a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection ofblockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure. We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

title: Executivo de território
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado para integrar nossa equipe comercial. Se você é apaixonado por desafios, tem atitude de dono e busca uma carreira de sucesso, essa oportunidade é para você!
Responsabilidades:
Visitar entre 8 a 12 Farmácias de pequeno e médio porte da região;
Planejar e identificar as oportunidades de vendas, verificar, executar MPDV, dentro das rotinas do PEX (Programa de Excelência) na base de PDVs;
Atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
Participar das reuniões diárias – matinal e fechamento de vendas on-line, de segunda à sexta.
Participar de treinamentos e eventos para atualização e desenvolvimento profissional;
Requisitos e qualificações
Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
Capacidade analítica verificar e atuar nas oportunidades;
Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;
Disposição para trabalhos externos e viagens estaduais;
Carteira de motorista B;
Experiência Comercial Bens de consumo, Bebidas, Sorvete, Canal conveniência, setor de Adquirência (desejável);
Proatividade, atitude de dono e foco em resultados;
Desejável: Cursando Ensino Superior (Cursos prioritários: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm,)
Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand: A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia; A Legrand hoje:
Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado;
Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano; História recente:
Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior;
Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos;
Novo lema “Viva a Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Descrição da Empresa Plataforma de carreira da nova economia com mais 10 mil alunos formados. Somos uma empresa de educação que oferece cursos, pós graduação e mestrados internacionais. Missão: Gerar oportunidades de crescimento e mudança de vida para profissionais da área que buscam sucesso e satisfação pessoal e financeira.
Visão: Ser a empresa referência no setor de educação para saúde e impactar mais de 100.000 vidas e 5.000 profissionais
Valores: Clientes no centro, verdade, ambição e sentimento de melhorias. Aqui no grupo Unilife acreditamos que o verdadeiro sucesso vem de uma equipe engajada e inspirada. Nossa cultura reflete nosso compromisso em criar um ambiente de trabalho que não apenas apoie o crescimento e o desenvolvimento profissional, mas também valorize cada membro da equipe, acreditamos que cada colaborador tem papel essencial na concretização da visão de impacto social da empresa. Aqui nossos colaboradores tem possibilidade e visão de crescimento no nosso ecossistema.
Estamos contratando Consultor de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe em Salvador, BA. As principais responsabilidades incluem atender clientes, buscar clientes, identificar suas necessidades e recomendar soluções educacionais alinhadas às suas metas. Você também será responsável por acompanhar negociações, esclarecer dúvidas e garantir um alto nível de satisfação do cliente. Este é um cargo presencial e em regime de contratação.
Qualificações
Consultoria de Vendas: Experiência em consultoria de vendas, conhecimento em estratégias de vendas e habilidade para identificar oportunidades no mercado. Relacionamento com o Cliente: Competência em manter a satisfação do cliente e oferecer um serviço de alta qualidade que corresponda ou supere as expectativas. Comunicação: Habilidades de comunicação clara e eficaz para interações cliente e equipe, auxiliando na resolução de dúvidas e esclarecimento de informações. Experiência em consultoria e atendimento ao cliente será um diferencial, assim como familiaridade com o setor educacional e ferramentas de CRM.
Informações Indispensáveis: Modalidade PJ de trabalho Modelo de trabalho híbrido: Segunda a sexta presencial e sábado home office.
O que é importante para o perfil: Desejo de crescer na sua carreira Desejo de sempre aprender novas habilidades Desejo de sempre melhorar suas técnicas Sempre está se capacitando sobre o tema vendas Desenvolve Skills de comunicação, relação interpessoal e inteligência emocional
Experiência: Mínimo de 30 vendas no período de 90 dias.
Remuneração Salário + Ajuda de custo + Comissão + bonificações
FIXO Júnior (até R$150.000) R$1.700 Pleno (R$151k–R$250k) R$2.200 Sênior (R$251k–R$300k) R$2.850 Expert (R$301k–R$320k) R$3.400

Quer fazer parte de um time que inova e impacta milhões? Sua jornada começa aqui!

title: Coordenador de obras - incorporação
description:

Experiência Comprovada: Vivência sólida na coordenação de múltiplas obras simultâneas no segmento de incorporação imobiliária (residencial ou comercial).
Formação: Graduação completa em Engenharia Civil com registro ativo no CREA.
Visão de Incorporação: Entendimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto imobiliário (do projeto à entrega das chaves/assistência técnica).
Responsabilidades e Atribuições Gestão Multiobras: Coordenar simultaneamente o andamento de diferentes canteiros, garantindo a padronização de processos e qualidade. Interface Estratégica: Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas de Projetos, Suprimentos e Financeiro da Incorporadora. Controle de Cronograma: Monitorar o caminho crítico das obras, antecipar riscos e propor planos de ação para desvios de prazo. Gestão de Custos: Acompanhar o fluxo de caixa das obras e o cumprimento do orçamento previsto (VGV/Custos diretos). Liderança de Equipes: Orientar os engenheiros residentes e equipes técnicas, promovendo um ambiente de alta performance e segurança. Qualidade e Normas: Garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas, PBQP-H e legislações municipais vigentes. Pré-requisitos Adicionais e Diferenciais Softwares de Gestão: Domínio de ferramentas de planejamento (MS Project ou Primavera) e ERPs de engenharia (Ex: Sienge , UAU ou Totvs). Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Lean Construction (Construção Enxuta) para otimização de processos. Gestão de Contratos: Habilidade na contratação e gestão de grandes empreiteiras e fornecedores críticos. Pós-Graduação: Especialização em Gestão de Projetos, Gestão de Negócios Imobiliários ou Engenharia de Custos será considerada um diferencial. Perfil Comportamental: Forte capacidade de negociação, resiliência para lidar com prazos desafiadores e excelente comunicação interpessoal.

description:

Strong proficiency in Alteryx Designer, with a deep understanding of Alteryx workflows, formulas, macros, and data integration processes.
Proficiency with Alteryx Server
Additional skills in Power BI or other data visualization tools are highly preferred.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact with clients in a professional and client-facing manner.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with great attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com perfil técnico-comercial para atuar como Executivo de Vendas em um segmento industrial altamente especializado, focado em soluções de detecção e separação de metais em processos produtivos.Se você gosta de desafios, tem perfil consultivo e quer atuar diretamente no campo, contribuindo com soluções técnicas que geram impacto real nos clientes, essa oportunidade é para você.Sobre a posição
Você será responsável por conduzir todo o processo comercial, desde a prospecção até o fechamento, com forte atuação em campo. Além disso, terá papel fundamental na demonstração prática de equipamentos, suporte técnico e desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas para clientes industriais.Principais responsabilidades:
Realizar prospecção ativa e visitas a clientes em diferentes regiões;
Conduzir apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de equipamentos em campo;

Apoiar testes, treinamentos e implementação de soluções junto aos clientes.O que buscamos:
Formação superior em Engenharia (Controle e Automação, Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção) ou cursos técnicos correlatos (Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Automação);
Experiência em vendas externas no segmento industrial;
Vivência com automação, instrumentação ou processos produtivos será um diferencial;
Conhecimento em ambientes industriais e linhas produtivas;
Inglês intermediário ou avançado;

Proatividade e autonomia;

title: Data analyst
description:
You will be working for a US-based technology company with the leading Software, Web and mobile app development for business in North America helping independent retailers adopt and embrace this new key component of their digital marketing solution. We build and maintain thousands of retailer websites that must run reliably, efficiently, and effectively.

Enforce data governance policies, standards, and best practices
Support data ownership, and lifecycle managementRequirements

Hands-on experience withMetaplane(required)

Experienced in Data Quality frameworks and tools
Strong experience in Data Analysis techniques and tools (SQL, Python, etc.)
Experience in Data Lineage concepts and tools
Business Glossary and metadata management
Data Governance and Data Stewardship practices
Experience working with modern data platforms (e.g., GCP, Big Query)
Strong SQL skills and experience querying large datasets
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
Strong English communication skills
