title: Llm scientist
description:
We are looking for an \" LLM Scientist \" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.Key Responsibilities
Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.
Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.About Our Client
Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM

title: Llm scientist
description:
We are looking for an " LLM Scientist " for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.Key Responsibilities
Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.
Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.
Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.
Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.Qualification Required
Extensive experience with Py Torch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).
Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.
Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS Sage Maker/GCP Vertex Al).
Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.Nice to Have
Advanced Degree: A Master's or Ph D in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.
Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.
Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).
Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public Git Hub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the Gen Al space.
Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.About Our Client
Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.

title: Implementation analyst
description:
Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:Brazil
Type:Full-Time Contract
Setup:Fully Remote
Level:Mid-Level
Industry:Software SAAS Company
Shift:US Hours
Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment:Available upon request
Rate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.
O que nós estamos procurando;
  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).
O que oferecemos;
  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso "Get Together" onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We're looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.

This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You'll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js
  • Deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes
  • Working with MongoDB in production environments
  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)
  • Identifying technical risks and proactively solving them
  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders

What We're Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments

More importantly, we're looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams

Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.

title: Data Specialist - Project
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Data Specialist with 5+ years of experience in data analysis, validation, and transformation. This role focuses on reviewing and validating data from multiple sources, ensuring accurate mapping into standardized formats, and maintaining high data quality across pipelines. The ideal candidate has experience working with raw data files, SQL-based systems, and AWS data environments.

This project has a 3-6 month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.

Responsibilities

  • Data Validation & Quality Assurance
  • Analyze raw data from clients, devices, and external sources
  • Validate that data is correctly processed, transformed, and stored
  • Identify inconsistencies, anomalies, and data quality issues
  • Ensure outputs match expected results after processing
  • Review and validate data mappings created by engineering teams
  • Ensure raw data is accurately converted into standard formats
  • Collaborate with data engineers to refine and improve mapping logic
  • Take ownership of data quality across systems and workflows
  • Establish and enforce best practices for data validation and integrity
  • Act as a guide for teams to ensure reliable data processing
  • Work closely with data engineering, application engineering, and product teams to ensure alignment on data needs
  • Provide feedback on data issues and recommend improvements
  • Bridge the gap between raw data ingestion and business-ready datasets

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of data validation experience
  • Strong analytical mindset with a focus on data quality and validation
  • Experience working with structured and semi-structured data
  • Ability to interpret and validate data transformations and mappings
  • Solid understanding of SQL and data querying
  • Experience working in data pipelines or data engineering environments
  • Hands-on experience with data formats such as CSV, JSON, XML, and flat files
  • Familiarity with SQL-compliant databases
  • Exposure to AWS-based data environments
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Apache Iceberg and working with event-based or sensor data (e.g., fuel systems, industrial, or IoT data) is a plus.
  • Experience with data platforms such as Apache Iceberg (or similar)

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior - DBT GCP
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR

Estamos buscando um Engenheiro de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Migração de Dados OnPrem para Google Cloud Platform (GCP) no setor financeiro. Esse profissional será responsável pela construção, otimização e orquestração de pipelines de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, eficiência e governança durante o processo de migração.

Descrição do Cargo:

O Engenheiro de Dados GCP Sênior será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Looker, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT, com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL, garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

Analisar e reestruturar processos de ETL, facilitando a migração para a nova arquitetura de dados.

Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções escaláveis.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

Experiência sólida com DBT, modelagem de dados e práticas de orquestração de pipelines.

Conhecimento avançado em BigQuerye Looker e estruturação de dados no Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Proficiência em SQL para otimização e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.

Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de scripts de transformação e automação de dados.

Conhecimento avançado em ETL (Informatica PowerCenter, Talend, DataStage, Hadoop e entre outras).

Experiência prévia em projetos de migração de dados e integração entre diferentes plataformas.

Diferencial: Vivência no setor financeiro e familiaridade com práticas de governança de dados.

Benefícios e Diferenciais:

Parceria com TotalPass para acesso a academias e atividades físicas.

Oportunidades de treinamento e cursos em tecnologias de dados.

Auxílio com certificações oficiais, com 100% de reembolso ou vouchers.

Parcerias com instituições de ensino para graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.

Contratação PJ.

Trabalho 100% remoto, atuando em cliente do segmento financeiro.

Sobre a ATRA:

A ATRA é referência em tecnologia e inovação, atuando há mais de 15 anos no mercado de engenharia de dados, data analytics, governança e privacidade. Somos parceiros de grandes empresas como Microsoft, Google, Informatica, Denodo, Atlan e BigID, desenvolvendo soluções que transformam dados em ativos estratégicos. Com um ambiente colaborativo e inovador, buscamos profissionais apaixonados por tecnologia e transformação digital.

title: Senior AI Technical Project Manager

Lead the end-to-end delivery of AI-powered digital initiatives across Quality and CMC operations. This role will drive cross-functional execution of AI use cases, ensuring alignment between Digital, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, and Data Science teams.

  • Ensure AI solutions are scalable, secure, and production-ready.

  • Drive documentation for audit readiness and inspection preparedness.
  • Manage data integrity standards (ALCOA+).
  • Understand system architecture (LIMS, MES, SAP, Veeva, data platforms).
  • Manage integration dependencies across enterprise systems. Partner with cloud, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams.
  • Oversee vendor technical performance.
  • Identify technical and regulatory risks early and drive mitigation.
  • Manage change adoption within Quality and CMC functions.
  • Develop communication plans for executive and operational stakeholders.
  • Define measurable KPIs (cycle time reduction, deviation reduction, automation rate).
  • Track ROI and business impact of AI initiatives.
  • Ensure sustainable scaling of successful pilots.

We have some requirements:

  • Previous experience in Technical Program Management, Digital Transformation, or Engineering Program Delivery.
  • Previous experience leading AI/ML or advanced analytics initiatives.
  • Experience in regulated industries (Pharma, Biotech, Medical Devices).
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML lifecycle and data governance.
  • Experience working with enterprise platforms (LIMS, MES, SAP, Veeva, etc.).
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

title: Mean Stack Developer
description:
MEAN Stack Developer

On a day-to-day basis you will be:

  • Understanding logical architectures for web applications using better practice design principles.
  • Leading the development of web applications with the support of a small development team (for lead roles).
  • Utilizing CI/CD workflows using build and release automation in Azure DevOps.
  • Application development based on screens, documented requirements, and user stories
  • Assisting with third level support by driving the resolution of application defects and supporting a response to major application incidents.
  • Coaching other developers and sharing your knowledge and expertise within the team.
  • Participating in firmwide software development forums and communities to share ideas and contribute to our body of knowledge.
  • Actively participating in daily team stand-ups, workshops, and online technical forums.

About you

Applicants must be able to demonstrate the following ke

y capabilities and behaviour:

  • Exceptional problem-solving and critical thinking skills, an analytical mindset and outstanding attention to detail.
  • Experience designing and developing javascript web applications using Node.Js, Angular 2+, CSS3, HTML5 and Javascript.
  • Experience developing middleware, integration and messaging systems using REST APIs and popular message bus platforms (e.g. RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus).
  • Strong understanding of event-driven, asynchronous programming concepts and best practice application design principles.
  • Strong understanding of non-relational database design and querying by using MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis or other.
  • Understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment, ideally using Azure DevOps (formerly Visual Studio Team Services).
  • Ability to work efficiently with remote teams using collaboration technology.
  • Ability to identify issues and solve complex problems as part of a team.
  • Ability to lead small development teams and foster strong working relationships (only for leads).
  • Ability to remain calm when under pressure and meet demanding deadlines.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • A proactive approach to resolving problems.

Ideally, you will also have:

  • Knowledge of ORM/ODM like Sequelize and Mongoose.
  • Experience with microservices architectures and containerisation using Docker.
  • Experience designing, developing and automating unit tests.
  • Strong understanding of source code version control, including the use of Git repositories.
  • Experience working on projects that follow an Agile Scrum methodology.
  • Strong awareness of system development life cycles (SDLC).
  • Good understanding of relational databases such as MS SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL or any other.

Desenvolver, manter e evoluir soluções com qualidade, usabilidade, desempenho e inovação, dentro dos prazos acordados, com supervisão mínima; tendo como foco a evolução da gestão em nossos clientes.

title: Orçamentista
description:
Orçamentista (Estimator)Objetivo da Função

Experiência na elaboração de orçamentos técnicos em projetos de fachadas e building envelope, com foco em sistemas de ACM e Attachment System, vidro arquitetônico e soluções de fachada. O profissional atuará diretamente na análise de documentos de projeto, levantamento de quantidades e preparação de propostas competitivas para novos projetos.Responsabilidades

  • Analisar projetos, especificações técnicas e documentos de licitação.
  • Realizar levantamento de quantidades (takeoffs) para sistemas de fachada, incluindo ACM, Vidro arquitetônico e outros sistemas de envelope.
  • Preparar orçamentos detalhados considerando materiais e custos indiretos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de projetos e compras para obter cotações de fornecedores.
  • Avaliar diferentes soluções técnicas para otimizar custos e competitividade das propostas.
  • Preparar e organizar pré-propostas comerciais e documentação de suporte.
  • Participar da revisão de escopo e alinhamento técnico com clientes e parceiros quando necessário.
  • Manter banco de dados atualizado de custos, fornecedores e referências de projetos anteriores.
Requisitos
  • Experiência comprovada como orçamentista na indústria de fachadas de mais de 5 anos, preferencialmente com sistemas de ACM, vidro arquitetônico e sistemas de fachada em geral.
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos e projetos arquitetônicos.
  • Experiência com levantamento de quantidades (material takeoff).
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e capacidade analítica.
  • Inglês avançado, pois todos os documentos e projetos e reuniões são em inglês.
  • Boa comunicação para interação com equipes técnicas e fornecedores.
  • O trabalho é 100% home-office.

title: Coordenador de obras - Incorporação
description:
Oportunidade: Coordenador de Obras (Incorporação)

Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Obras com perfil dinâmico e visão estratégica para integrar nosso time de Engenharia. Este profissional será o elo entre o planejamento da incorporadora e a execução técnica no canteiro, garantindo que nossos empreendimentos sejam entregues com excelência, dentro do prazo e do orçamento.Requisitos Fundamentais (Obrigatórios)

  • Experiência Comprovada: Vivência sólida na coordenação de múltiplas obras simultâneas no segmento de incorporação imobiliária (residencial ou comercial).
  • Formação: Graduação completa em Engenharia Civil com registro ativo no CREA.
  • Visão de Incorporação: Entendimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto imobiliário (do projeto à entrega das chaves/assistência técnica).
Responsabilidades e Atribuições
  • Gestão Multiobras: Coordenar simultaneamente o andamento de diferentes canteiros, garantindo a padronização de processos e qualidade.
  • Interface Estratégica: Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas de Projetos, Suprimentos e Financeiro da Incorporadora.
  • Controle de Cronograma: Monitorar o caminho crítico das obras, antecipar riscos e propor planos de ação para desvios de prazo.
  • Gestão de Custos: Acompanhar o fluxo de caixa das obras e o cumprimento do orçamento previsto (VGV/Custos diretos).
  • Liderança de Equipes: Orientar os engenheiros residentes e equipes técnicas, promovendo um ambiente de alta performance e segurança.
  • Qualidade e Normas: Garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas, PBQP-H e legislações municipais vigentes.
Pré-requisitos Adicionais e Diferenciais
  • Softwares de Gestão: Domínio de ferramentas de planejamento (MS Project ou Primavera) e ERPs de engenharia (Ex: Sienge, UAU ou Totvs).
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Lean Construction (Construção Enxuta) para otimização de processos.
  • Gestão de Contratos: Habilidade na contratação e gestão de grandes empreiteiras e fornecedores críticos.
  • Pós-Graduação: Especialização em Gestão de Projetos, Gestão de Negócios Imobiliários ou Engenharia de Custos será considerada um diferencial.
  • Perfil Comportamental: Forte capacidade de negociação, resiliência para lidar com prazos desafiadores e excelente comunicação interpessoal.
